# Third-party notices

The Windows model loader uses Monocypher. Its BSD-2-Clause / CC0 dual-license and upstream notice are included in `ring_mac_sdk/licenses/monocypher.md` in the wheel.

Bleak (including its Windows Runtime dependencies), NumPy, ONNX Runtime and optional aiohttp are installed as dependencies under their respective upstream licenses. Windows mouse output calls system APIs through Python ctypes.

Ring-specific code and model artifacts remain subject to the rights holder's authorization. This delivery grants no new open-source license for those materials.
